text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Take a look at this, Trainer. I've received a letter from a fan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The letter's handwriting is so immaculate I almost want to frame it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: It was penned by an elderly lady who has supported the Mejiro family since the height of my grandmother's career.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "You have planted your roots slowly, yet firmly. The steady growth you display is most befitting of the Mejiro mantle."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe! It is, but it's a great honor as well. She's recognized me as a member of the Mejiro family, and is expecting greatness from me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ryan, McQueen, the previous generation, and the generation before that—the Mejiro family tree is tall and illustrious…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And I have been given the opportunity to add my name to its branches.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I vow to become an Umamusume capable of shouldering that responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And there is no time like the present.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'm planting my roots in the earth. Can't you tell? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As per usual, she's marching to the beat of her own drum. But in her eyes, I see a fighter's spirit and a burning pride.
